physical_blocks.exact_text: Protocol: CPX-POM-001 --- DELIVERY TYPE ---- Page 1 of Y
Percentages are based on the number of patients enrolled.
[a] A patient completed Cycle 1 if s/he attended visit Day 10 (if Cycle 1 was not the last cycle).

[b] A patient completed Cycle 2 (or any next cycle) if s/he attended visit Day 6 (if Cycle 2 or any next cycle was not the last
cycle).

[c] A patient completed the Last Cycle if s/he attended the last visit of the cycle (visit Day 10 for Cycle 1 or visit Day 6 for
Cycle 2 or any next cycle) and if s/he attended the final visit at least 22 days after the first dose in the last cycle.
[d] Calculated as [(Date of end of study – Date of first dose) + 1]/30.4375.
